title: Fairness: synthetic tenure gap and a real-data check
summary: Synthetic world: long-tenure customers' scams were missed more often; we tested an equal-opportunity fix and built a policy dial. Real messages (BTTC): we found and fixed a channel bias that synthetic data could not reveal.

headline.label: Gap in missed scams across tenure groups
Real messages: SMS vs Telegram gap in missed scams

sections.title: Real messages: are SMS scams caught as well as Telegram scams?
sections.lead: BTTC, real Bangla messages (CC BY 4.0). 92% of the Telegram messages are scams but only 3.6% of the SMS, so a model trained on the mix learns the channel's style instead of the scam. Pilot model trained on 3,000 real labels; thresholds set on validation for 90% recall; 5 seeds, one test pass each.
sections.takeaway: SMS scams caught: 30% → 90%; the gap in missed scams falls from 67 to 3.5 points. Synthetic data could not have shown this bias.

sections.title: What the fix costs, on the same real messages
sections.lead: Normal messages wrongly flagged, by channel and by writing (Bangla script vs Bangla mixed with English). Mean of 5 seeds.

rows: Bangla mixed with English, one threshold
Bangla mixed with English, per-group thresholds

sections.takeaway: Closing the channel gap flags 9.7% of normal SMS instead of 0.4%: a real cost, shown to the policy owner. The lasting fix is more real SMS scam labels (only 280 in this dataset).

sections.title: Missed scams by account tenure, before and after group-aware thresholds
sections.lead: Thresholds per tenure group chosen on validation so each group reaches the overall recall; one test pass.
sections.takeaway: The gap falls from 10.4% to 3.2% and overall recall rises, but false pauses rise from 8.3 to 13.6 per 1,000.

sections.title: A policy dial instead of a hidden choice
sections.lead: Lowering only the long-tenure threshold step by step: how much gap closes per extra false pause.
sections.takeaway: A budget-neutral search on validation found no threshold set that narrows the gap without more false pauses, so the trade-off is shown to the policy owner as a dial.

caveats: The tenure study is synthetic; the real-data check covers the text model (BTTC has no customer attributes). Transaction-level fairness on real data is part of the pilot plan.
Tenure, channel and writing are not protected characteristics; no sensitive attribute is used or invented.
